name: הוצאת גורם משותף – שלושה איברים axy + by² − cy (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Factorise the following:

\[ {{CT:0}}. \]

[[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: The common factor is the highest common factor (hcf) of the coefficients times every letter that appears in all the terms, each with its lowest power. Divide every term by it, write the quotients in a bracket, and check by expanding.
Step 1 — The common factor
The terms are \({{CT:1}}\), \({{CT:2}}\) and \({{CT:3}}\). The coefficients are

\[ {{CT:4}}={{CT:5}}\cdot 1,\qquad {{CT:6}}={{CT:5}}\cdot 2,\qquad {{CT:7}}={{CT:5}}\cdot 3 \]

and \(1,2,3\) have no common factor other than \(1\), so the hcf of the coefficients is \({{CT:5}}\). The letter \(y\) appears in all three terms, with powers \(1\), \(2\) and \(1\); the lowest power is \(1\). The letter \(x\) appears in the first term only. So the common factor is

\[ {{CT:8}} \]

Step 2 — Dividing each term by the common factor
Each term divided by \({{CT:8}}\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:1}}}{{{CT:8}}}=x,\qquad \frac{{{CT:2}}}{{{CT:8}}}=2y,\qquad \frac{{{CT:3}}}{{{CT:8}}}=-3 \]

The quotients go into the bracket:

\[ {{CT:0}}={{CT:8}}\left(x+2y-3\right) \]

Step 3 — Check and answer
Check by expanding the brackets:

\[ {{CT:8}}\cdot x+{{CT:8}}\cdot 2y-{{CT:8}}\cdot 3={{CT:0}} \]

So the factorised form is

\[ {{CT:0}}={{CT:9}}. \]
